A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] was a '''son''' to a [[Unidentified naval father|father]] who served in the [[Imperial Navy]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[4 BBY]], they were a [[cadet]] in the Navy and together with their father attended the [[Wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding]] of the [[Chandrilan]]s [[Stekan Sculdun]] and [[Leida Mothma]]. 

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|The man's father|Well, it's a proud tradition in our family. We've all treasured our naval service.|Luthen Rael|And where are you stationed?|The young man|I've been training on Steergard, but we're all being transferred now.|Luthen Rael|Really? Where's everyone going?|attr=The young man talking with Luthen Rael and their father|src=<ref name="One Year Later" />}}
[[File:LuthenVeryInterested-OYL.png|thumb|300px|left|Luthen Rael was very interested to know where the cadet was being transferred.]]
A young [[human]] [[Gender|male]], they came from a family with a proud tradition of [[Navy|naval]] service. In [[4 BBY]], they were a [[cadet]] in the [[Imperial Navy]] and was training on [[Steergard]] before they found out they were being transferred. During the same year they attended the three-[[Local day|day]] [[Wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding]] [[Stekan Sculdun]] and [[Leida Mothma]] at the [[Mothma Estate]] on [[Chandrila]] with their [[Unidentified naval father|father]]. During the first day of the wedding they chatted about their military service with [[Luthen Rael]] inside one of the estate's buildings.<ref name="One Year Later" />

On the second day of the wedding, the young man and their father attended the wedding dinner on the estate during which [[Perrin Fertha]], the father of the Leida, gave a speech from in the center of the room, welcoming the guests in [[Chandrilan (language)/Legends|Chandrilan]] and toasting his health before offering advice to Stekan and Leida.<ref name="Sagrona">{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}</ref> One the final day, the son and father were part of the crowd that watched Davo unveil his wedding gift to the newly-weds, a [[Chandi Merle]] statue. Soon after, they watched Leida and Stekan perform a dance after which the guests mingled. A [[speaker droid]] then entered the room and began playing [[Niamos!|music]] for the guests to dance to.<ref name="Harvest">{{Andor|Harvest}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
The young man had light skin and [[Color|brown]] [[hair]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Equipment==
During the wedding, they wore a white and gold naval cadet [[Imperial military uniforms|uniform]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Behind the scenes==
The son was portrayed by [[Harry Cornell]] in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's first three episodes "[[One Year Later]]", "[[Sagrona Teema]]", and "[[Harvest]]", which were all released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
